Section 1, the Digital Edition of Fernando Pessoa (pessoadigital.pt): 'A digital scholarly edition and research framework'; it 'connects with ... the Estranhar Pessoa project hosted by the Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH) and the National Library of Portugal collection'. findings: THE EDITION REACHED, AT THE GRAIN OF ITS KIND. 'A digital scholarly edition and research framework dedicated to the works and manuscripts' of Pessoa: the CCeH's page gives 'a digital edition of the editorial projects and publications of the Portuguese author Fernando Pessoa (1888–1935)'. What it edits is not carried: 'Above all, handwritten notes, lists and plans with which Pessoa conceived his work are edited. These will be juxtaposed with his works published during his lifetime' (the CCeH's page). The plans and lists in which Pessoa assigned his works to their names are the edition's object and the census's reason for holding it.

THE HOST MISASSIGNED. The composition has 'the Estranhar Pessoa project hosted by the Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH)'. The CCeH's page, carded first, says 'The digital edition is hosted by the DCH' and points to Estranhar Pessoa as a framework project 'running since mid-2013' at its own address. The CCeH was a participant in the edition (2014–2016); the editors (Ulrike Henny-Krahmer, Pedro Sepúlveda, Jorge Uribe) are named on the CCeH's page and nowhere in the composition.

THE SECOND SENSE. João Pessoa na Palma da Mão, an app of the municipality of João Pessoa in Brazil, takes the second section and three of the five cards, all Instagram videos. The edition's title as the University of Rostock card gives it, 'Fernando Pessoa. Projects and Publications', is not composed.
